from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Reference(BaseModel):
    """A paper referenced in this document's bibliography that is also in the provided collection."""
    title: str = Field(description="The exact title of the referenced paper as it appears in this paper's bibliography")
    citation_index: str | None = Field(description="Optional citation number or label from the bibliography, e.g. '[10]'")

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """One paper from the collection: its title and which other provided papers it references."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="This paper's title as it appears in the document")
    references_provided_papers: list[Reference] = Field(description="Other papers from the collection that appear in this paper's reference list")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
